mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(locked_until > now(), false) AS locked, COALESCE(CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (locked_until - now()))), 0)::bigint AS retry_after_seconds FROM login_failures WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_failures (email, failure_count, locked_until, updated_at) VALUES ( #{email}, 1, CASE WHEN 1 >= #{maxFailures} THEN now() + make_interval(mins => #{lockMinutes}) END, now() ) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET failure_count = CASE WHEN login_failures.locked_until IS NULL THEN login_failures.failure_count + 1 ELSE 1 END, locked_until = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN login_failures.locked_until IS NULL THEN login_failures.failure_count + 1 ELSE 1 END) >= #{maxFailures} THEN now() + make_interval(mins => #{lockMinutes}) END, updated_at = now()
